name: gumroad
description: 57 shared Gumroad commerce tasks with private seller/license profiles and per-call approval.
long_description: 51 native tool contracts over 50 distinct routes plus 6 compatibility/local helpers. 25 reads and 32 confirmed effects. Official CLI and MCP already exist. OAuth import, automatic retries, transaction guarantees and measured task-token savings are not advertised.

api_key.title: Private seller access token
api_key.description: Private seller Bearer access token; choose this OR token_file. Endpoint scopes govern authority.

token_file.title: Private seller token file
token_file.description: Absolute owner-private regular non-symlink file outside repositories. Choose instead of api_key; restrict Windows ACLs.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide and directly refuse 32 native/local effects, including exports.

license_key.title: Private independent license key
license_key.description: Independent private customer license; choose this OR license_file. Verification sends false; seller license effects also require a seller token.

license_file.title: Private license-only file
license_file.description: Absolute owner-private regular non-symlink license-only file. Verification needs no seller token; seller management does.
